method.identity: Actual literal card-name argument in unindented top-level val = card(...) or val = basicLand(...) assignments in mtg-sets/**/src/main/**/definitions/**/*.kt; comments stripped. A private face requires an explicit inspected public doubleFacedPermanent wrapper. Printings, tests, filenames, and card-name mentions alone are not definitions. This is a static source inventory, not a compiled registry load.
method.aliases: Unicode NFKD diacritic-folded case comparison only; original deck spelling and canonical source name are both retained; transform-front names resolved through archived card_faces.
method.scenario: Declared <CardSymbol>ScenarioTest classes in scenario test sources; filename presence alone is insufficient; execution remains unqualified.
method.digest_format: SHA-256 of sorted path TAB content-sha256 records joined with LF; no trailing LF.
